question: How can the ten teachers appear distinct yet remain full of knowledge?
premises: The teachers manifest according to the sequence of their own partial mental activities.
They appear mutually distinct in consciousness and activity, yet they are full of knowledge.
inference: Their individual differences belong to their embodied manifestation, while their essential nature remains complete in knowledge.
plain_english: Following the sequence of their own partial mental activities, they assume human bodies; even though they appear distinct from one another in consciousness and activity, they are fully complete in knowledge.
